dock_guide.text: Devonport. King William III ordered a dockyard here in 1691, and the town that grew up round it was called Plymouth Dock until 1824.
Ships of the line, then ironclads, then submarines. It's the biggest naval base in Western Europe now. Mind you, I'd say that about my allotment.
That frame there's a model of an old wooden hull. Oak from the forests of half of England went into the ships of Nelson's day. Thousands of trees for one big ship.
